your_meta_prompt.content: Program: validity-domain atlas for GPU kernels. Every optimization is a conditional claim with a domain in (shape,dtype,layout,tolerance,arch); spine hypothesis: boundaries collapse to simple surfaces in derived coords (waves, bytes/thread, AI, occupancy, working-set/L2). Comparator: torch.compile, not eager. Numbers carry derived coords or do not exist. Policies: P1 provenance-tagged constants; P2 results schema or the result is not real; P3 harness commits carry data; P4 adoption names its first boundary; P5 doubt needs a written falsifier + 2-class no-collapse; P6 bootstrap sessions from artifacts never memory; P7 no policy theater. Kill-switch: no-collapse in 2 families => 'domains irreducibly high-dim per arch' reframe. Instruments before claims; variance fields mandatory; measurement-washing is the quiet enemy.
